name: Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd. (厦门海辰储能科技股份有限公司)
employees: ~7,650 (FY2024, company ESG figure via aggregator); ~10,500 (Mar 2026, third-party workforce estimate)
summary: Hithium is a pure-play stationary energy-storage battery manufacturer founded in December 2019 by former CATL engineer Wu Zuyu. It mass-produces prismatic LFP cells purpose-built for storage (280Ah, 314Ah, 587Ah, 1175Ah, and 1300Ah classes), sodium-ion cells, and integrated battery energy storage systems (∞Block and ∞Power DC blocks up to 6.9 MWh) for utility-scale, C&I, and residential applications, selling to grid operators, developers, and integrators in 20+ countries. The company remains private as of August 2026: an A-share attempt was withdrawn in 2023 and two Hong Kong Main Board applications (March 2025, October 2025) both lapsed, the second in April 2026.
ecosystemRole: One of the world's largest ESS cell suppliers — No. 5 globally in 2023 (>15 GWh, InfoLink), No. 3 in 2024 (35.1 GWh, ~11% share, behind CATL and EVE), and Top 2 in both total and utility-scale ESS battery shipments for 2025 (InfoLink/SMM/ICC); cumulative shipments passed 100 GWh in August 2025. Manufacturing: Xiamen HQ, Chongqing (world's first WEF 'Lighthouse Factory' in energy-storage batteries, Jan 2026), Shandong, a 10 GWh/yr module + system plant in Mesquite, Texas (first shipments Aug 2025), and a committed €400M cell + BESS gigafactory in Navarre, Spain (target 2027).

productsAndServices.name: Utility-scale LFP storage cells (∞Cell line)
productsAndServices.description: Prismatic LFP cells purpose-built for stationary storage: ESS Cell 280Ah (≥7,000 cycles), 314Ah (≥13,000 cycles), ∞Cell 587Ah (mass delivery from 2025), ∞Cell 1175Ah (world's first mass-produced kAh-class cell, Chongqing, from June 2025), ∞Cell 1300Ah for 8-hour LDES (mass delivery targeted Q4 2026), and a 650Ah cell slated for 2027.
highlights: Cells supplied to integrators including NHOA, Risen Energy, and (formerly) Powin alongside Hithium's own systems
∞Cell 1175Ah earned UL 1973 and UL 9540A certification at SNEC 2025

productsAndServices.name: Containerized utility-scale systems (∞Block / ∞Power)
productsAndServices.description: DC blocks from the ∞Block 5.016 MWh (314Ah cells) to ∞Power 6.25 MWh 2h/4h variants in a standard 20-ft container (587Ah / 1175Ah cells), a 6.9 MWh 8-hour system (1300Ah cell, Q4 2026), the modular 10-ft ∞Power Flexsso, and a hardened 'Desert Eagle' variant rated -30°C to 60°C.
highlights: 4 GWh Saudi Electricity Company LDES projects (Tabuk and Hail, with Alfanar; reported RMB 2.6B supply deal; commissioning targeted 2026)
2 GWh to Ukraine via KNESS Group from Q1 2026; 2 GWh Eastern Europe framework with Bulgaria's Solarpro
Statkraft cooperation for a wind-farm BESS in Navarre and a 30.1 MWh project in France (July 2026)
Prospectus customers include Jupiter Power, Lightsource bp, Samsung C&T, Datang Group, and Longyuan Power

productsAndServices.name: Sodium-ion products (∞Cell N162Ah / ∞Power N)
productsAndServices.description: The ∞Cell N162Ah (launched December 2024) is billed as the first sodium-ion battery specialized for utility-scale storage — NFPP cathode with hard-carbon anode, ~94.2% retention after 4,000 cycles, projected >20,000 cycles to 70% SOH, and a -40°C to 60°C operating window; paired with the ∞Power N 2.28 MWh (1h) system.
highlights: GWh-scale mass production planned from Q4 2025

productsAndServices.name: C&I storage
productsAndServices.description: ∞Block 261 kWh and ∞Power 418 kWh cabinet-class DC blocks for commercial & industrial applications, alongside earlier-generation 5 MWh 20-ft containers.

productsAndServices.name: Residential & portable power (HeroEE line)
productsAndServices.description: HeroEE portable/home backup products — HeroEE 1 (1,004.8 Wh) and HeroEE 2 (built-in 2 kWh, up to 10,000 cycles, launched June 2024) — plus home energy-storage system solutions.

productsAndServices.name: Localized manufacturing & delivery
productsAndServices.description: US module and full-BESS assembly in Mesquite, Texas (~484,000 sq ft, ~$200M, 10 GWh/yr, first shipments August 2025) for the North American market; committed European cell + BESS production in Navarre, Spain (€400M JV with Sodena, ~700 jobs, €81M Spanish government grant, target 2027); long-term O&M included in the Saudi SEC projects.

financials.commentary: Private company — figures from HKEX prospectus filings and media summaries; no analyst consensus exists. Funding: Series B ~RMB 2.0B+ (Oct 2022), Series C >RMB 4.5B (~US$622M, Jul 2023); media valuation estimates RMB 25–30B (2025). Risk context flagged by financial media: three failed listing attempts (A-share withdrawn 2023; HKEX applications lapsed Sep 2025 and Apr 2026), 10+ CATL lawsuits claiming >RMB 240M, a partial equity freeze on the controlling shareholder's vehicle (Feb 2026, until Feb 2029), and FY2024 profitability's dependence on subsidies.
